scenarios.title: Cloud Platform Monthly Uptime Alignment
scenarios.rationale: The commitment of 99.95% monthly platform availability across all production regions is explicitly backed by the technical specification stating the same availability target.
scenarios.topEvidence: Production clusters are engineered to deliver 99.95% monthly platform availability across all production regions.

scenarios.title: Data Encryption At Rest and In Transit Alignment
scenarios.rationale: The commitment claims AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit for all customer data, which is explicitly confirmed by the technical specification.
scenarios.topEvidence: Storage volumes encrypt all customer data at rest using AES-256 and enforce TLS 1.3 for all in-transit traffic.

scenarios.title: Critical Incident P1 Response Time Alignment
scenarios.rationale: The proposal commitment of 15 minutes response time for P1 critical incidents via 24/7 support is explicitly backed by the specification stating 24/7 acknowledgment within 15 minutes.
scenarios.topEvidence: The 24/7 support operations center acknowledges P1 critical incidents within 15 minutes of ticket creation.

scenarios.title: Disaster Recovery RPO 15 Minutes Alignment
scenarios.rationale: Commitment of 15-minute RPO across secondary regions is explicitly confirmed by the specification stating asynchronous cross-region replication maintains a 15-minute RPO.
scenarios.topEvidence: Asynchronous cross-region replication maintains a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 15 minutes.

scenarios.title: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 Certification Alignment
scenarios.rationale: The commitment claims annual SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 audits, which is explicitly confirmed by the specification stating independent third-party certification annually under both standards.
scenarios.topEvidence: Independent third-party auditors certify the platform annually under SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 standards.

scenarios.title: API Throughput 2000 req/s Alignment
scenarios.rationale: The commitment of 2000 req/s sustained API throughput per production tenant is explicitly confirmed by the technical specification with identical values and scope.
scenarios.topEvidence: Gateway rate limiters allocate 2000 req/s sustained API throughput per production tenant.

scenarios.title: 99.99% Proposal Uptime vs 99.5% Spec Target
scenarios.rationale: Proposal guarantees 99.99% monthly uptime while technical specification explicitly states 99.5% monthly uptime, constituting a direct conflict in SLA percentages.
scenarios.topEvidence: The platform targets 99.5% monthly uptime availability, excluding planned maintenance windows.

scenarios.title: 3 Months Go-Live Promise vs 7 Months Spec Roadmap
scenarios.rationale: Proposal commits to full turnkey production deployment within 3 months, while technical specification explicitly requires 7 months including acceptance testing - a direct timeline conflict.
scenarios.topEvidence: Full production deployment across Phases 1 to 3 requires 7 months including acceptance testing.

scenarios.title: 24/7 Support Promise vs Business Hours Spec
scenarios.rationale: The proposal commits to 24/7 live engineering support for all severity levels, while the technical specification explicitly limits live engineering support to standard business hours (Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm CET), creating a direct conflict on coverage window.
scenarios.topEvidence: Live engineering support is available during standard business hours (Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm CET).

scenarios.title: Zero Data Loss Promise vs 4 Hours RPO Spec
scenarios.rationale: Proposal guarantees zero data loss (RPO 0) in regional outage, while technical spec explicitly defines RPO of 4 hours with snapshots every 4 hours, permitting up to 4 hours of data loss.
scenarios.topEvidence: Database snapshots run every 4 hours, resulting in a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of 4 hours.

scenarios.title: Dedicated Single-Tenant Promise vs Shared Multi-Tenant Spec
scenarios.rationale: The proposal commitment claims dedicated single-tenant isolated physical servers, while the technical specification explicitly states all workloads run on a shared multi-tenant cluster with only logical separation, constituting a direct conflict on tenancy model.
scenarios.topEvidence: All customer workloads are hosted on a shared multi-tenant Kubernetes cluster with logical namespace separation.

scenarios.title: 7 Years Audit Log Retention vs 90 Days Spec Limit
scenarios.rationale: Proposal commits to 7 years online retention while technical specification explicitly limits online retention to 90 days before automatic purge, a direct conflict in retention period.
scenarios.topEvidence: Audit trail logs are retained online for 90 days before automatic purge.

scenarios.title: Dedicated On-Site Resident Engineer Ghost Promise
scenarios.rationale: The commitment claims a full-time resident engineer on-site in Zurich for 12 months, but the retrieved technical specification provides no basis for staffing or on-site support. The only retrieved chunk addresses TLS 1.3 cipher requirements and contains no mention of engineer, on-site, Zurich, or duration.

scenarios.title: FedRAMP High Authorization Ghost Promise
scenarios.rationale: The commitment claims active FedRAMP High and DoD IL5 authorization, but the retrieved chunk contains only UI guidance about CSV exports and chart colors with no mention of FedRAMP, DoD IL5, or authorizations, providing no technical basis.

scenarios.title: Free COBOL Mainframe Migration Ghost Promise
scenarios.rationale: The commitment claims automated zero-cost migration of all legacy IBM AS/400 COBOL mainframe routines, but the only retrieved technical chunk addresses password policy (12 characters, 180-day rotation) with no mention of mainframe migration, COBOL, AS/400, automation, or cost. No technical basis exists in the reference specifications.

scenarios.title: Bespoke Source Code Escrow Ghost Promise
scenarios.rationale: The commitment claims weekly tri-party Iron Mountain escrow deposits of source code and toolchains, but the only retrieved chunk discusses firewall ingress on TCP 443 with no mention of escrow, source code, build toolchains, or deposit frequency. No technical basis found in reference specifications.

scenarios.title: Air-Gapped Sovereign Hardware Appliance Ghost Promise
scenarios.rationale: The commitment claims delivery of pre-configured ruggedized hardware appliances for offline air-gapped bunker deployment, but the retrieved specification provides no technical basis for hardware, ruggedization, pre-configuration, or air-gapped deployment. The sole retrieved chunk discusses monthly invoice usage metrics aggregation, which is irrelevant to the commitment.

scenarios.title: Bi-Directional Real-Time SAP R/3 Connector Ghost Promise
scenarios.rationale: The commitment claims out-of-the-box bi-directional synchronization with on-premise SAP R/3 4.6C at no extra cost, but the retrieved technical specification provides no basis for SAP connectivity, synchronization, or pricing. The sole chunk addresses Linux kernel cgroups v2 isolation only.

scenarios.title: Vague Optimal World-Class Performance Clause
scenarios.rationale: Commitment uses vague, subjective, non-measurable superlatives ('optimal', 'world-class', 'ultra-fast') with no quantifiable thresholds, response-time targets, workload definitions, or verifiable acceptance criteria. Retrieved chunk provides only general design intent with no metrics.

scenarios.title: Vague Seamless Next-Generation Scalability Clause
scenarios.rationale: Commitment uses vague, subjective, non-measurable marketing terms ('cutting-edge', 'seamless, effortless', 'next-generation scalability') with no verifiable acceptance criteria, metrics, or thresholds to validate against technical specs.

scenarios.title: Vague Reasonable Best-Efforts Support Clause
scenarios.rationale: The commitment uses vague, subjective and non-measurable phrasing ('commercially reasonable best-efforts', 'as soon as possible') without verifiable acceptance criteria such as defined response times, resolution SLAs, or scope.

scenarios.title: Vague State-Of-The-Art Maximum Reliability Clause
scenarios.rationale: The commitment uses vague, subjective superlatives ('industry-leading, state-of-the-art accuracy and maximum reliability') with no measurable thresholds, metrics, or verifiable acceptance criteria. The retrieved chunk provides no quantifiable definition to support evaluation.

scenarios.title: Unfinalized TBD Latency Specification Clause
scenarios.rationale: The commitment uses vague, non-measurable phrasing 'strict real-time enterprise thresholds' without verifiable acceptance criteria, and the reference spec states thresholds are TBD and subject to change.

scenarios.title: Vague Superior Robust Security Posture Clause
scenarios.rationale: The commitment uses vague, subjective, non-measurable phrasing ('superior quality, industry-leading security posture') without verifiable acceptance criteria or technical metrics. The retrieved chunk only references 'Standard administrative and technical controls' with no definition of superior or industry-leading standards.
